text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=router, from=3% to=10%, version=v2.14.0. Auto-monitoring enabled. (logs: https://deploys/redwood/1768123460)

alex: saw a drainback alert — traffic pulled to 2% within 6m. error spike on eu-west. :eyes:

maya: copying alert — 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 3.8% at ~06:12 UTC. Any immediate rollback criteria hit?

jun: looks like tokenization microregression in edge shard, stack traces show LLM tokenizer OOMs on long inputs. small batch of failed requests, not system-wide. sample ids attached.

ops-oncall: can we confirm scope? is it just eu-west node pool or global?

alex: so far eu-west only. incidents dashboard: cpu/kb spike on gpu-12, kv-cache evictions up.

deploy-bot: Canary auto-throttle engaged: target=2% (policy: latency>300ms || 5xx>1%).

alex: proposal A: hold at 2% and let infra evict/rehabilitate for 20–30m. Proposal B: rollback to v2.13.9 now. Thoughts?

sre-lead: prefer hold and investigate unless error rate continues rising. Do we have a hotfix ready?

jun: reproducer found on long prompts with certain leading tokens — we can patch tokenizer config but needs a minor model-side tweak, ~45m deploy.

maya: if we hold, can we pin traffic to fallback model variant for eu-west only? That buys time without global rollback.

deploy-bot: Traffic-shift command available: /deploy traffic set router eu-west fallback=v2.13.9-percent=100 --dry-run

alex: run the shift if ops approves. That avoids full rollback.

ops-oncall: +1 for targeted fallback. Can you run it, alex? I'll monitor infra and warm caches.

alex: running now.

```
/deploy traffic set router eu-west fallback=v2.13.9-percent=100 --reason "canary drainback: tokenization OOMs" 
```

deploy-bot: OK: initiated traffic shift to v2.13.9 in eu-west. Expected stabilization within 60s.

jun: monitoring logs — error rate in eu-west dropping back toward baseline. kv-cache eviction rate falling.

maya: thanks. SRE, ops — if eu-west stabilizes, do we lift the canary (resume 10%) or continue staggered warmup to 5%?

sre-lead: let's be conservative: keep global canary at 2% until we validate 30m of stable telemetry post-shift. If all clear, progressive to 5% with additional warmup.

alex: ack. Logging action: hold, targeted fallback in eu-west, no global rollback. Will update release notes and assign follow-up jira.

ops-oncall: watching latency and 5xx. I'll ping if any regression reappears. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary state: paused (2%). Fallback active in eu-west -> v2.13.9. Auto-rollback disabled while manual review in progress. (cmd id: cb-1768123460-01)

maya: created JIRA INF-4829: "canary tokenization OOMs — patch v2.14.0" and added reproducer + logs + rollout timeline.

alex: thanks team. We reconvene in 25m for decision to lift to 5% or rollback. Please add any observations to the jira thread.

sre-lead: noted. If anything spikes, hit the deploybot /deploy rollback immediately.

jun: will have patch ready for QA in ~35m. If verified, we can promote and continue gradual ramp.

ops-oncall: closing loop — monitoring green so far, will report at reconvene. :white_check_mark:
